zh-HK: Customer Report 報表中心：下拉選單換成分類卡片，有說明、搜尋、★ 最愛、最近使用及數據狀態
一頁設定取代逐個彈窗：報表參數、時間基準、Segmentation、數據欄位、帳號及聯絡人一頁過揀，即時摘要同驗證
記住每份報表上次設定，卡片「⟳ 上次設定」一撳重跑；可儲存命名 Preset 喺報表中心直接產生
報表先開預覽：排序、搜尋、Sales Area／Handle By 篩選、欄位顯示、合計、分頁及跳行
新增 Excel 匯出（凍結標題、篩選、金額／% 格式、負數紅色、報表設定 sheet）及複製表格貼去 Excel／Outlook；CSV 內容不變
Customer Report 修正：Top N「兩者」模式 crash、欄位錯位及漏咗數據欄位設定；Segmentation Report 問兩次 EDM；New Customer 無下單期間快選日期
修正：Margin Uplift 開住時新加報價行再套用會重複加價；Sales History 批量分析 CSV 匯出 crash；CSV／JSON 編輯器提示唔顯示；EDM 冇 Logo 時 crash
客戶資料欄恢復即時提示（必填、電話、Email 格式紅框，唔會擋儲存）；剔選格唔再被螢幕閱讀器讀成文字框
en: Customer Report centre: the dropdown is now categorised cards with descriptions, search, favourites, recently used and data status
One-page setup replaces the chain of pop-ups: report options, time basis, segmentation, data columns and account/contacts on one page with live summaries and validation
Each report remembers its last settings with one-click "⟳ Last settings" reruns; save named presets and run them from the report centre
Reports open in a preview first: sort, search, Sales Area / Handle By filters, column picker, totals, paging and go-to-row
New Excel export (frozen header, filters, money / % formats, red negatives, report settings sheet) and copy-table for Excel / Outlook; CSV content unchanged
Customer Report fixes: Top N "both" mode crash, misaligned columns and dropped data-column settings; Segmentation Report asking for EDM twice; New Customer no-order quick dates
Fixed: new quotation rows getting Margin Uplift applied twice when re-applied; Sales History batch-analysis CSV export crash; CSV / JSON editor messages not showing; EDM crash when no logo is set
Customer fields show live hints again (required, phone, email format; saving is never blocked); checkboxes are no longer announced as text boxes by screen readers
